description:
**Greenfield reference implementation.** Write a fresh `memory::MemoryBackend` for `jmap-contacts-server` from scratch, following the canonical pattern landed by .1 (mail-server).

This crate currently has no `tests/` directory at all. Implementation work, not refactor.

## Mechanical steps

1. Read the canonical pattern from .1 (jmap-mail-server's `src/memory.rs`).
2. Read the `ContactsBackend` trait surface in `crate-jmap-contacts-server/src/`.
3. Implement a minimal `MemoryBackend` covering every required trait method. `Arc<Mutex<MemoryState>>`, HashMap storage, hand-rolled change tracking.
4. Add `feature = "memory"` to Cargo.toml. Gate `pub mod memory;` in lib.rs.
5. Create `tests/common/mod.rs` (≤ 200 LOC helpers) and `tests/contacts_tests.rs` with 4-8 happy-path tests + 2-4 error-path tests.
6. Add `[dev-dependencies] jmap-contacts-server = { workspace = true, features = ["memory"] }`.
7. Use RFC 9610 / JMAP Contacts draft examples as test oracle where possible. Hand-written JSON fixtures.

## Test minimum

- `AddressBook/get`, `AddressBook/changes`, `AddressBook/set`, `AddressBook/query`, `AddressBook/queryChanges` (5 tests)
- `ContactCard/get`, `ContactCard/changes`, `ContactCard/set` (3 tests)
- 2-4 error-path: invalidProperties, notFound, forbidden

Total: ~10-12 tests, ~400-600 LOC for tests file.

## Coordination with architecture work

The architecture work in JMAP-sehw (create jmap-jscontact-types) and JMAP-lbdy is mostly API-preserving for contacts-server:
- sehw: new typed sub-types in a new crate; contacts-types re-exports. contacts-server's view is unchanged.
- lbdy: additive `extra` field on in-scope structs.

Recommend: construct types via `serde_json::from_value` from JSON fixtures in this child's tests. Style is immune to additive type changes.

## Acceptance

- `cargo test -p jmap-contacts-server --features memory` clean — at least 8 tests pass.
- `cargo test -p jmap-contacts-server` clean.
- `cargo check -p jmap-contacts-server --no-default-features` clean.
- `cargo clippy -p jmap-contacts-server --features memory --tests -- -D warnings` clean.
- `cargo doc -p jmap-contacts-server --features memory --no-deps` clean.
- Naming, layout, feature flag exactly match canonical (.1).
- Total new LOC: 800-1500 (reference impl) + 400-700 (tests) ≈ 1200-2200 LOC.

## Depends on

JMAP-hwdv.1 (mail-server canonical).

## Effort estimate

1-3 days.
title: Greenfield MemoryBackend + tests in jmap-contacts-server (mirror canonical)
